evidence.quote: At 800 /C14 C, a region with serrated structures consisting of several parallel lathes were observed ( Fig. 10a), and each lath had a length of hundreds of nm and a width of tens of nm. The <1 21 3 > SAED pattern indicated that the lathes are a hex- agonal close-packed (HCP)-structured phase (a ¼ 310.6 p.m., c ¼ 474.4 p.m.), in which there are twins with {1 1 01} twinning

In addition, a few needle-shaped phases were observed in the same coarse grain ( Fig. 10d), which were also arranged in a parallel orientation. The SAED pattern of this site indicated two co-existing BCC phases with similar crystal parameters (a ¼ 332.3pm), and an orientation of {01 1} BCC1k{110} BCC2, <011> BCC1k<001> BCC2 (Fig. 10 e). Elemental line scanning of this region indicated spinodal decomposition between Nb and Ti/V. One of the decomposed phases was Nb-rich, with a disordered BCC structure (typically referred to as the A2 phase) based on the SAED identiﬁcation. Moreover, the composition of this A2 phase ﬂuctuated along the separation direction, and was approximately Ti27eV23eNb46eZr4.
